statement: Self-test of a proposed draft. Passing is not certification, adoption, or a security review.

results.title: Agent manifest is served at the well-known path, signed by a published key, and says the draft is not adopted
The REST manifest path serves the same content (same etag)
Action contracts: published list equals the manifest; no action approves or confirms; firm and admin actions are HTTPS-only
OpenAPI 3.1 document and error catalog are served
An unsupported OLIP-Version header is refused with VERSION_UNSUPPORTED
Starting a workflow needs an Idempotency-Key, and the same key replays the same workflow
Event journal: chain and signatures verify; a forged cursor is refused
Preview sends nothing; sending before the user approves returns USER_APPROVAL_REQUIRED; the assistant cannot approve
A changed approval digest is refused
After the user approves (mock inbox), the disclosure is sent once; a retry with the same key replays
results.detail: uses the host's mock inbox to read the user's one-time code

results.title: A client agent cannot record a firm event
Only the signed-in user exports a capsule; it validates, and a tampered copy fails
Import needs the user's authorization, creates no approvals, and works once
The planner is deterministic and says it is not authorization
Callback URLs that point at internal addresses are refused
Another user's assistant cannot see this workflow (NOT_FOUND)
Every checked response matched the published schemas (28 responses)
